data.title: Bitcoin DAT Strive’s Board Director Pierre Rochard Buys ASST Stocks as SATA Nears Par Value
data.description: Pierre Rochard, a director on the board of Bitcoin treasury company Strive, purchased 15,900 ASST shares. ASST stock price jumped more than 1% in premarket hours on Wednesday as SATA perpetual preferred stock approaches par value. Ad Ad Bitcoin Advocate Pierre Rochard Makes First Strive Stock Buy Pierre Rochard, CEO of The Bitcoin Bond Company,
